title: Vendor Risk Tiers
description: An interactive concentric-ring infographic that tiers a vendor portfolio (Tier-1 critical, Tier-2 important, Tier-3 standard) around the organization, with hover tooltips for the controls that fit each tier and a fourth-party (subprocessor) cluster showing inherited risk.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Classify vendors into risk tiers based on the impact of their failure or breach.
Match the depth of due-diligence controls to each tier rather than applying one questionnaire to all.
Explain fourth-party (subprocessor) risk and why it is inherited.

instructionalStrategies: Hover each ring and example vendor to reveal the typical controls for that tier.
Discuss why a single questionnaire for all vendors over-burdens low-risk suppliers and under-scrutinizes critical ones.

assessmentQuestions.question: Why does applying the same due-diligence questionnaire to every vendor produce a worse outcome than tiering?
A vendor's CDN suffers a breach that exposes your data. You never signed a contract with the CDN. How is that risk classified, and where would you have found it disclosed?
